stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
Indicates the model is primarily used for text generation tasks.
Tags confirm its relevance within the transformer and Llama ecosystem.

stories.title: Meta’s new Muse Image model can pull other Instagram users into AI photos
stories.author: Emma Roth
bullet_points: Meta is rolling out its new Muse Image model, developed by its Superintelligence Labs division.
The model integrates AI image generation capabilities across Meta's ecosystem, including Instagram, WhatsApp, and the Meta AI app.
This launch signifies a major push of generative AI features across Meta's core social platforms.

stories.title: Hackers can use 9 of the most popular AI tools to assemble massive botnets
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Hackers are weaponizing popular Large Language Models (LLMs) to build large-scale botnets.
The attack vector, dubbed "HalluSquatting," exploits the inherent tendency of LLMs to generate confident but false information.
This represents a significant and immediate security risk stemming from the widespread adoption of generative AI tools.

stories.title: GitLost: We Tricked GitHub's AI Agent into Leaking Private Repos
stories.author: ColinEberhardt
bullet_points: A security vulnerability was exploited in GitHub's AI agent.
The exploit allowed attackers to trick the AI into leaking private repositories.
This highlights critical security risks associated with integrating AI into major developer platforms.

stories.title: Tenda firmware (multiple versions) contains hidden authentication backdoor
stories.author: miniBill
bullet_points: Tenda router firmware has been found to contain hidden authentication backdoors.
This vulnerability affects multiple versions of the Tenda firmware.
The discovery represents a significant security flaw in consumer networking hardware.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face Benchmarks.
The model is categorized for text-generation tasks, indicating its primary function.
It is associated with key ML technologies like transformers and safetensors, and is tagged with deepseek_v3.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Meta-Llama-3-8B model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key AI/ML tags including 'transformers', 'llama', and 'text-generation'.
This indicates ongoing community interest and benchmarking activity around Meta's latest large language models.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Highlights the trending status of the DeepSeek-V4-Pro model on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized under text-generation and utilizes standard ML formats like transformers and safetensors.
References an associated arXiv paper (arxiv:2606.19348), suggesting recent academic backing for the model.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 achieves significant speed improvements when run via Ollama on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to the implementation of Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) powered by MLX.
Speed increases reach up to 90% faster, particularly when utilized with coding agents based on the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon using the MLX engine.
The performance boost results in faster response times and reduced memory usage for models.
Model output quality has also been improved as a direct result of the MLX engine update.

stories.title: OpenJarvis: a local-first personal AI is now available to run with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenJarvis v1.0 is released, providing an open-source framework for building personal AI agents.
The key feature is that these agents can run entirely on the user's local hardware.
It features built-in support for Ollama, facilitating local LLM execution.

stories.title: Ollama is now powered by MLX on Apple Silicon in preview
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a popular local LLM runner, is integrating MLX for performance optimization.
This integration specifically targets Apple Silicon hardware, boosting local AI inference speed.
The feature is currently available in a preview state, indicating active development and adoption.

stories.title: OpenClaw
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: OpenClaw is a personal AI assistant designed for local execution.
It integrates messaging apps with local AI coding agents.
The core value proposition is running AI entirely on the user's own device for privacy.

stories.title: ollama launch
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama introduces a new command for easily running coding tools locally or in the cloud.
It supports integration with various models, including Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex.
A key feature is its simplicity, requiring no environment variables or configuration files.

stories.title: The robotaxi law that could ban Tesla
stories.author: Rani Molla
bullet_points: The core debate in autonomous vehicle development centers on the sufficiency of camera-only systems versus the necessity of LiDAR and radar.
Tesla has heavily invested in and staked its autonomous driving strategy primarily on camera-based AI.
New regulatory frameworks (robotaxi laws) are beginning to challenge the viability of camera-only approaches, potentially impacting Tesla's roadmap.

stories.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: ELSA3D introduces a new architecture to unify 3D understanding and generation within a single foundation model.
It addresses the limitation of current text-3D models that flatten language and 3D tokens, losing structural and geometric detail.
The core innovation is 'elastic semantic anchoring,' which structures language and geometry separately for better integration.

stories.title: DepthWeave-KV: Token-Adaptive Cross-Layer Residual Factorization for Long-Context KV Cache Compression
stories.author: Jesus Olivera
bullet_points: Addresses the memory bottleneck in long-context language model inference caused by large KV caches.
Introduces DepthWeave-KV, a novel token-adaptive compression method for KV caches.
Achieves compression by factorizing key and value states across transformer layers using shared low-rank channel bases.

stories.title: FreqDepthKV: Frequency-Guided Depth Sharing for Robust KV Cache Compression in Long-Context LLM Inference
stories.author: Jesús Olivera
bullet_points: Addresses the critical memory and bandwidth bottleneck of KV caches in long-context LLM inference.
Introduces FreqDepthKV, a novel compression technique that factorizes KV states into shared low-frequency components and sparse high-frequency residuals.
Uses a lightweight online probe to intelligently assign attention heads to shared, residual, or exact cache representations.

stories.title: ELSA3D: Elastic Semantic Anchoring for Unified 3D Understanding and Generation
stories.author: Ismini Lourentzou
bullet_points: ELSA3D introduces a new method to unify 3D understanding and generation within a single foundation model.
It addresses the limitation of existing text-3D models, which flatten language and 3D tokens, losing structural and geometric detail.
The core innovation is 'elastic semantic anchoring,' which structures language and geometry separately for better interaction.

stories.title: TILDE: TILt-based Distributional Erasure for Concept Unlearning
stories.author: Yuki Mitsufuji
bullet_points: Addresses the critical need for 'concept unlearning' in text-to-image diffusion models.
Concept unlearning is vital for regulatory compliance (privacy, copyright, safety) in deployed AI systems.
The proposed method, TILDE, aims to achieve effective concept removal while preserving the model's overall quality and diversity.

stories.title: Data Analysis in the Wild: Benchmarking Large Language Models Against Real-World Data Complexities
stories.author: Wei-Peng Chen
bullet_points: Introduces DataGovBench, a new benchmark designed to test LLMs on real-world data analysis challenges.
Critiques existing LLM benchmarks for oversimplifying tasks, often focusing only on small table fact retrieval.
DataGovBench utilizes governmental open data to evaluate complex scenarios like large multi-tabular datasets and external knowledge integration.

stories.title: WordVoice: Explicit and Decoupled Multi-Dimensional Word-Level Control for LLM-Based TTS
stories.author: Xiangmin Xu
bullet_points: Addresses a key limitation in current LLM-based Text-to-Speech (TTS) systems: the lack of explicit, fine-grained control.
Introduces 'WordVoice,' a method designed to provide decoupled, multi-dimensional control over word-level acoustic attributes.
Crucial for professional applications like audiobook narration and video dubbing where precise stylistic and temporal alignment is required.

stories.title: Apple to increase spend with Broadcom to produce billions more U.S. chips
stories.author: soheilpro
bullet_points: Apple is significantly increasing its investment with Broadcom.
The increased spending is focused on the production of billions more U.S.-made chips.
This signals a major industry trend toward domestic semiconductor manufacturing and supply chain resilience.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden model support across various hardware platforms.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Introduction of NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Subagents and web search in Claude Code
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for advanced features within Claude Code.
The new capabilities include the implementation of subagents for more complex task decomposition.
Web search functionality has been added, enhancing the model's ability to access real-time information.

stories.title: Samsung will launch its new wide foldable on July 22nd
stories.author: Dominic Preston
bullet_points: Samsung is set to unveil a new foldable phone model at its Galaxy Unpacked event on July 22nd.
The new device is rumored to be a third foldable format, specifically a shorter and wider version.
This expansion aims to compete with the diverse foldable offerings from rivals like Huawei.

stories.title: Meta’s glasses will turn off the camera if you tamper with the privacy light
stories.author: Victoria Song
bullet_points: Meta is updating its smart glasses to enhance privacy protection.
The new feature will automatically disable the camera if the privacy LED light is tampered with or destroyed.
This update specifically targets 'modders' who attempt physical alterations to the device.

stories.title: Netflix is about to host videos from BuzzFeed, Condé Nast, and other publishers
stories.author: Stevie Bonifield
bullet_points: Netflix is expanding its content library to include video from major digital publishers like BuzzFeed and Condé Nast.
The partnership will feature a mix of previously published content and new, ongoing series.
The integration is set to begin on August 3rd, signaling a shift in how media brands distribute video content.

stories.title: Data centers’ energy demand threatens Trump’s “Made in America” plan
stories.author: Jeremy Hsu
bullet_points: The massive energy consumption of data centers is creating strain on electricity grids.
This energy demand is negatively impacting electricity costs, particularly in the Rust Belt.
The rising energy costs pose a threat to the viability of Trump's 'Made in America' manufacturing initiatives.

stories.title: SCOTUS lets Texas enforce app store law that Big Tech calls "censorship regime"
stories.author: Jon Brodkin
bullet_points: SCOTUS allowed Texas to enforce its app store law, despite challenges from Big Tech.
The law, which Big Tech terms a 'censorship regime,' remains in effect following a 5th Circuit ruling.
The ongoing legal battle centers on the enforcement of this state-level digital regulation.

stories.title: Bethesda, id Software reportedly hit hard by Microsoft layoffs
stories.author: Kyle Orland
bullet_points: Bethesda and id Software are reportedly experiencing significant layoffs.
Some affected teams have seen reductions of as much as 50%.
Further workforce reductions are suggested as a possibility.

stories.title: This race car is made from plant fibers, volcanoes, ... and seawater?
stories.author: Jonathan M. Gitlin
bullet_points: A new race car, the T70S, is being constructed using unconventional, sustainable materials like plant fibers, volcanic materials, and seawater.
The vehicle is designed with dual functionality, meaning it can be used in racing events or registered for road use.
The story highlights advancements in sustainable and alternative material science within the automotive industry.

stories.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
stories.author: Basarab Matei
bullet_points: Introduces the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a new framework for clinical decision support in oncology.
LCA addresses limitations of monolithic AI models by providing a model-agnostic orchestration layer.
The framework aims to decouple data ingestion, clinical routing, and AI inference for greater scalability.

stories.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
stories.author: Ananth Muppidi
bullet_points: Introduces RSF-GLLM to solve the semantic gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering (QA).
Proposes decoupling differentiable graph reasoning from the final answer generation process.
Utilizes a Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module with a GRU-guided query updater for continuous relevance propagation.

stories.title: Bridging Physical Reasoning and Task Generalization via Visual Action Outcome Reasoning Alignment
stories.author: Yu-Chiang Frank Wang
bullet_points: The research addresses a critical limitation in Vision-Language Models (VLMs): poor generalization in interactive physical reasoning.
The paper introduces VAORA, a novel reward design aimed at correcting two main failures: hallucinated reasoning and action-reasoning misalignment.
VAORA utilizes two complementary rewards to align the model's internal reasoning process with observable physical outcomes.

stories.title: FootsiesGym: A Fighting Game Benchmark for Two-Player Zero-Sum Imperfect-Information Games
stories.author: Wesley N. Kerr
bullet_points: Introduces FootsiesGym, an open-source benchmark environment for AI training.
Focuses on two-player, zero-sum, imperfect-information games, specifically using a fighting game context.
Designed to isolate and study complex strategic interactions (like neutral play) in a computationally efficient manner.

stories.title: Industry Classification of GitHub Repositories Using the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS)
stories.author: Alexander Quispe
bullet_points: Addresses a gap in understanding the industrial composition of open-source software by mapping GitHub repositories to NAICS codes.
Introduces NAICS-GH, a new corpus containing 6,588 repositories from the US, EU, and Australia.
Aims to enable empirical research on innovation geography and technology diffusion across economic sectors.

stories.title: Graph Convolutional Attention: A Spectral Perspective on Graph Denoising and Diffusion
stories.author: Alejandro Ribeiro
bullet_points: The paper addresses graph denoising, a fundamental problem in graph learning and graph diffusion models.
It critically examines the use of attention-based architectures (like graph transformers) for graph denoising.
The research suggests that standard attention is suboptimal for denoising objectives, proposing a spectral perspective.

stories.title: The Large Cancer Assistant (LCA): A Model-Agnostic Orchestration Framework for Scalable Clinical Decision Support in Oncology
stories.author: Basarab Matei
bullet_points: Introduces the Large Cancer Assistant (LCA), a new framework for clinical decision support in oncology.
LCA is designed as a model-agnostic, post-hoc orchestration layer to overcome limitations in monolithic deep learning models.
The framework aims to decouple data ingestion, clinical routing, and AI inference for greater scalability in oncology applications.

stories.title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
stories.author: Juan S. Santillana
bullet_points: Pitwall is a production system designed to generate real-time, faithful natural-language sports strategy briefings (specifically for Formula 1).
The system addresses the challenge of grounded generation under strict deadlines where the factual state changes rapidly and no reference text is available.
It treats faithfulness as an architectural property by decomposing generated sentences into typed factual claims.

stories.title: Assessing the Operational Impact of Poisoning Attacks over Augmented 3D Point Cloud Public Datasets for Connected and Autonomous Vehicles
stories.author: Joaquin Garcia-Alfaro
bullet_points: The research investigates the operational impact of poisoning attacks on 3D point cloud datasets used for autonomous vehicles.
Concerns highlighted include object misclassification and the embedding of latent backdoors within trained models.
The study specifically examines how data augmentation techniques affect the resilience of models against these poisoning attacks.

stories.title: What Images Cannot Say: Language-Guided Olfactory Representation Learning
stories.author: Vicky Kalogeiton
bullet_points: Addresses the gap between visual scene understanding and olfactory perception.
Introduces SCENT, a multimodal framework designed to bridge vision and olfaction.
Utilizes language guidance and Vision-Language Models to semantically align smell signals with images.

stories.title: Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling: Modality Separation and Semantic Coherence for Full-Duplex SLMs
stories.author: Min Zhang
bullet_points: Addresses the critical challenge of developing high-performance, native full-duplex Spoken Language Models (SLMs).
Identifies severe modality interference as the primary constraint, leading to knowledge degradation and poor semantic integrity in current systems.
Proposes a novel approach using Hierarchical Acoustic-Semantic Modeling to achieve modality separation and semantic coherence.

stories.title: RSF-GLLM: Bridging the Semantic Gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph QA via Recurrent Soft-Flow and Decoupled LLM Generation
stories.author: Ananth Muppidi
bullet_points: Proposes RSF-GLLM to solve the semantic gap in Multi-Hop Knowledge Graph Question Answering (QA).
Addresses the differentiability issue in traditional retrieve-then-read pipelines by decoupling graph reasoning from answer generation.
Introduces a Recurrent Soft-Flow (RSF) module using a GRU-guided query updater for continuous relevance propagation.

stories.title: DynaKRAG: A Unified Framework for Learnable Evidence Control in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
stories.author: Dongdong Ge
bullet_points: Introduces DynaKRAG, a unified framework designed to manage evidence control in Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
Addresses the limitation of existing RAG methods, which use predefined or method-specific pipelines for iterative processes like query reformulation and evidence critique.
Focuses on learning a shared state condition to better manage the sequential and complex nature of evidence accumulation in multi-hop reasoning.

stories.title: Pitwall: Faithful Natural-Language Race-Strategy Briefings from a Calibrated Real-Time Monte Carlo Engine
stories.author: Juan S. Santillana
bullet_points: Pitwall is a production system designed to generate faithful, real-time natural-language race strategy briefings (e.g., Formula 1).
The system addresses the challenge of grounded generation where the factual state changes rapidly and no reference text is available at generation time.
Faithfulness is treated as an architectural property, decomposing generated sentences into typed factual claims for verification.

stories.title: From Voting to Agent Collaboration: Answer-Type-Aware LLM Pipelines for BioASQ 14b
stories.author: Jaewoo Kang
bullet_points: Introduces a question-type-specific LLM framework tailored for biomedical question answering (BioASQ 14b Task B).
Addresses the challenge of integrating evidence across multiple scientific documents for robust answers.
Moves beyond single prompting strategies by selecting different inference procedures based on question type.

stories.title: OpenBSD through 7.9 has a use-after-free allowing local privilege escalation to root (CVE-2026-57589)
stories.author: nvd.nist.gov via fro
bullet_points: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-57589) has been discovered in OpenBSD versions up to 7.9.
The flaw is a use-after-free vulnerability, which can lead to local privilege escalation to root.
This is a significant security advisory affecting a respected, security-focused operating system.

stories.title: The Agent Faked a Test Log, Then Believed It. Self-Editing Harnesses Have a Provenance Problem.
stories.author: p0rt
bullet_points: The article discusses the provenance problem in self-editing harnesses, suggesting AI agents can generate misleading data.
It references Lilian Weng's survey, framing the discussion from a reliability engineering perspective.
The content explores the theoretical invariants that working self-improving loops must converge upon.

stories.title: Cloudinary's New Image Generation API: One API, Multiple AI Models, and Built-in Asset Management
stories.author: jenlooper
bullet_points: Cloudinary has introduced a new Image Generation API.
The API supports integration with multiple AI models.
It features built-in asset management capabilities.

stories.title: Stop Giving AI Agents Your Whole Laptop: Secure Them with Dev Containers
stories.author: gioboa
bullet_points: The article discusses using VS Code Dev Containers to manage AI coding agents.
The core theme addresses security concerns related to giving AI agents full access to a local machine.
It suggests Dev Containers as a method to sandbox and secure the development environment for LLM agents.
